title: Dob Hunter
notes: Dob Hunter, the Ravel Nexus's gambler (commander-armies.md): variance as a build. His army requires the Ravel faction and brings his unit and his own powers. Where a Citizen plans, Dob posts a price: his Bounty pays credits for what falls near him, so his economy is the fight itself, and his Loaded Dice make every exchange a throw. He has no campaign yet; he plays in duels (src/duel/).

card.title: Dob
card.subtitle: Your Commander
card.description: Dob Hunter posts a price on the enemy and throws charges from the second rank. If he falls, he goes up with a bang.

content.notes: The gambler: a Ravel Commander whose economy runs on the fight. He throws charges from the second rank (range 4, gently) at a Ravel's pace. Bounty: every enemy that falls within 6 of him pays his side 3 credits next round, 15 for a building, so a fight he stands in is income. Loaded Dice: one hit in four deals three times as much, from the battle's own seeded stream. When he falls he goes up like any Ravel (a blast of 12 within 2), and the Nexus restores him the next round. Lighter than both Citizens. First fixtures, no balance claim.

powers.name: Rigged Charges
powers.notes: His few, the commander-armies.md list: every runner's burst reaches two tiles.

powers.name: Lucky Scrap
powers.description: Bounty pays 3 more for each kill.
powers.notes: Wreckage pays more: his Bounty's price doubles, for the rest of the mission.

powers.name: Hot Dice

powers.notes: The dice warm up: one lucky hit in three instead of four.

powers.notes: Paid in advance: two raiders join and stay.
